{"metadata":{"description":"A kanban board inside DeepSeek Harness, integrated with the conversation: the agent writes planning cards via kanban tools while you talk, boards are isolated per workspace (project), and data is persisted to disk.","id":"gh:1334858274","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-project-kanban","slug":"StruggleYang/dsh-project-kanban","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A kanban board inside DeepSeek Harness, integrated with the conversation: the agent writes planning "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"cards via kanban tools while you talk, boards are isolated per workspace (project), and data is pers"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"an tools while you talk, boards are isolated per workspace (project), and data is persisted to disk."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-project-kanban"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A kanban board inside DeepSeek Harness, integrated with the conversation: the agent writes planning "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"cards via `kanban_*` tools while you talk, boards are isolated per workspace (project), and data is "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"*` tools while you talk, boards are isolated per workspace (project), and data is persisted to disk."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"This is an official **bundle**-format plugin (`dsh.bundle` declaration + `cordis.patch.yml` patch la"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"yer), installed through the official `dsh plugin` flow."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Agent-driven planning**: 9 model tools (`kanban_get`, `kanban_add_card`, `kanban_update_card`, `"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"kanban_delete_card`, `kanban_move_card`, `kanban_duplicate_card`, `kanban_add_column`, `kanban_renam"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e_column`, `kanban_delete_column`) — the agent writes cards directly during planning and feature bre"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"akdown
- **Per-workspace isolation**: each workspace (project) has its own board; agent tools resolv"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"e the current workspace automatically
- **Disk persistence**: every change is written to `kanban-boa"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"rd-<workspaceId>.json` — survives page refresh and process restarts
- **Browser board UI**: a "看板" ("},{"id":"p7s7","text":"Kanban) tab in the session header, no extra install
- **Labels & colors**: 功能 (feature, blue) / 缺陷 ("},{"id":"p7s8","text":"bug, red) / 文档 (docs, green) / 优化 (optimization, orange)
- **Priority**: high / medium / low with a "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"colored left-edge bar (red / orange / blue)
- **Custom card color**: any `#rrggbb` background via th"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"e color picker in the edit form
- **In-column ordering & duplication**: ↑ / ↓ buttons (or the `toInd"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ex` parameter) reorder cards within a column; one-click duplicate copies label/priority/color
- **Fi"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ltering & search**: keyword, label, and priority filters at the top of the board
- **Due dates**: YY"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"YY-MM-DD deadline with automatic overdue highlighting
- **Trash & restore**: delete is soft (to the "},{"id":"p7s14","text":"trash); restore or purge from the trash view
- **Bulk operations**: multi-select cards to move / lab"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"el / trash in one action
- **Stats bar**: totals by label, priority, and overdue count
- **Drag reor"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"dering**: drag a card onto another card's position to insert there
- **Templates**: default / dev / "},{"id":"p7s17","text":"content column presets (adds missing columns only)
- **Undo**: every write operation is undoable (50"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"-step stack)
- **Cross-workspace move**: move a card into another project's board
- **Session refere"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"nces**: cards created by the agent record their source session (click to jump back)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation (official flow)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- `dsh` CLI installed (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` or `pnpm dsh` from source)
- Pick the target **profile"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"** (`web` is the default browser profile)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Option 1: from GitHub (recommended)"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**pnpm ≥ 10 refuses to run a git dependency's `prepare` script on the first try.** Copy the package "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"key pnpm prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace."},{"id":"p13s3","text":"m prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then re-run `add`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Security note**: `allowBuilds` grants install-time code execution on your machine. Only allow"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" sources you trust, and consider pinning a commit: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:StruggleYang"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"/dsh-project-kanban#<commit-sha>`"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Option 2: from a local checkout"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Option 3: tarball / npm (no build permission needed)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Download the tarball from the GitHub Releases page, or build it locally:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Published to npm:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Verify and enable"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Then **restart `dsh web`** (bundle rows load at boot). The 8 `kanban_*` tools appear in the agent's "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"toolset, and the "看板" tab appears in the session header."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Removes both the dependency and the layer; board data files are kept on disk."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- This package is a **bundle** (npm package + config layer): `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.pat"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ch`, and `dsh` appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`
- `co"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"rdis.patch.yml` inserts the `dsh-project-kanban` row; the Loader resolves it by package name from th"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"e profile's `node_modules`
- `index.js` is a standard Cordis function plugin (`export const name` / "},{"id":"p31s5","text":"`export const inject` / `export function apply`) registering tools via `ctx.tools.register`
- The br"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"owser half (`lib/client.js`) is a hand-written `__ModuleLoader__` closure bundle (official client-mo"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"dules format): `require('react')` resolves via the platform seed word, and the UI talks to the host "},{"id":"p31s8","text":"through a same-origin `fetch` to the `/api/kanban` webServer route
- Tools resolve the current works"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"pace via `exec.agent.session.header.cwd` → `ctx.workspaceRegistry.resolveByPath`
- Layer order: `@de"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"epseek-ai/dsh-base` → this bundle → the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` → user `--patch` overlays; late"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"r layers override earlier rows by id"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Agent tools"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `kanban_get` | Read the current board (optional `includeArchived` for the trash) |
| `kanban_add_c"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ard` | Add a card (title, note, optional label / priority / color / dueDate) |
| `kanban_update_card"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"` | Update title / note / label / priority / color / dueDate |
| `kanban_delete_card` | Soft-delete "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"into the trash |
| `kanban_restore_card` | Restore a card from the trash |
| `kanban_purge_card` | P"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ermanently delete a card |
| `kanban_bulk_delete_cards` | Bulk soft-delete multiple cards |
| `kanba"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"n_move_card` | Move across columns, or reorder within a column via `toIndex` |
| `kanban_duplicate_c"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"ard` | Duplicate a card (carries all fields) |
| `kanban_move_card_to_workspace` | Move a card to an"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"other workspace's board |
| `kanban_undo` | Undo the last write operation |
| `kanban_add_column` / "},{"id":"p34s9","text":"`kanban_rename_column` / `kanban_delete_column` | Column management |"}],"truncated":true}
